name: WhatsApp
description: Let people start and continue Paperclip work with an agent from WhatsApp, using a phone number you link by QR code.

methods.label: Chat with an agent
methods.whenToUse: Let people in WhatsApp start and continue work with one Paperclip agent.
methods.guidanceMd: Use a dedicated WhatsApp number for this agent. Paperclip shows a QR code: open WhatsApp on that phone, go to Linked devices, and scan it (or link with a pairing code instead). Direct messages only; each person links their WhatsApp number to their Paperclip account before the agent acts for them. This uses WhatsApp's linked-device protocol rather than the WhatsApp Business API, so use a number you are prepared to have restricted by WhatsApp.
